info.title: OPTIMUS-THY API
info.description: API para el sistema de gestión clínica e inferencia IA de cáncer de tiroides

get.description:
Expose job metrics in Prometheus exposition format.

Metrics exposed:
- optimus_thy_jobs_total: Total number of jobs by type and status
- optimus_thy_inference_jobs_total: Total inference jobs by status
- optimus_thy_ocr_jobs_total: Total OCR jobs by status
- optimus_thy_inference_job_duration_seconds: Histogram of inference job durations
- optimus_thy_ocr_job_duration_seconds: Histogram of OCR job durations
- optimus_thy_inference_jobs_pending: Number of pending inference jobs
- optimus_thy_inference_jobs_active: Number of running (locked) inference jobs
- optimus_thy_workers_active: Number of active workers based on locked jobs
